$comment: Tests that may pass only on their CI retry (docs/plans/ci-stability.md D1). Each entry: test ('<file> › <describe…> › <title>' as the CI flaky summary prints it), owner, added and expires (ISO dates, at most 14 days apart), and reason. Fix the cause and remove the entry before it expires.

tests.test: http/boards-route-cutover.spec.ts › Boards workspace regional activity › Board activity formats the workspace timestamp and keeps its zone in the tooltip
tests.reason: First CI attempt did not find the 'Board activity' list in the board dialog within 5 s; the retry passed. The PR changes no Boards source file and not this spec. Find the race and remove this entry.

tests.test: http/sandbox-relationship-mappings.spec.ts › editing select choices preserves IDs, even when a label matches the default ID
tests.reason: First CI attempt timed out in locator.selectOption after the page loaded; the retry passed. It passed 5 of 5 alone and 250 of 250 with the whole spec at 4 workers locally, without retries. The PR changes no select-choice code. Find the race and remove this entry.

tests.test: http/comms-refactor-journeys.spec.ts › a channel row names its state, and leaving a channel marks it read
tests.reason: First CI attempt still showed 'workshop, marked unread' after switching channels; the retry passed. It reproduces on main: 1 failure in 198 whole-spec runs at 4 workers, the same assertion (the open channel's read mark is not saved). The PR changes no Comms read-state code. Find the race and remove this entry.
